state_of_the_art.statement: The best known 12-element set with distinct subset sums has largest element 1157 (V. Popov, 2025, recorded in OEIS A276661), below the Conway-Guy value 1164 (OEIS A005318). Exact values are known only up to n = 10 (309), and the Dubroff-Fox-Xu bound gives at least binomial(12,6) = 924 for n = 12.
